mechanism: Disulfiram inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, increasing aripiprazole plasma concentrations and risk of adverse effects including akathisia, extrapyramidal symptoms, and orthostatic hypotension.
action: Monitor for increased aripiprazole-related adverse effects; consider dose reduction of aripiprazole if co-administered with disulfiram; monitor blood pressure and neurological status.
